verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat workspace, so a compliance export of message history is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no admin export of workspace history in machine-readable formats, and nothing about including private conversations under policy. History search for agents, the moderation-focused admin API and the open Nostr/NIP-29 protocol are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an export capability.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can export the full message history of my workspace in machine-readable formats, including private conversations where policy allows
